label: Adobe Acrobat Reader
description: Opens and fills in PDF files. Installed for every user on this computer; may ask for administrator permission once. Does nothing if Adobe Reader or Acrobat is already installed, and uninstall only removes it if this setup installed it.
notes: Probed on windows-latest (winget 1.11): winget install/uninstall both exit 0, uninstall ~38 s, no ARP entry left afterwards. Not on the runner image.
